com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Change setup goals, preferred accounting destination, currency, locale, timezone or routine-work preferences. Currency preferences leave document amounts unchanged. Provider connections, tax treatment and automatic export are managed separately in IPP. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes. Preview only; nothing is applied until you confirm.
examples: Preview setting our setup goal to review, bookkeeping currency to USD, locale to en-US and timezone to America/New_York. Explain that these preferences leave document amounts unchanged, then wait for my confirmation.
Preview marking our intake and automation routine choices as manual. Show only those preference changes and wait for my confirmation.

description: Prepare setup goal, preferred provider, currency/locale/timezone or routine choices. Does not connect a provider, change tax treatment or enable automatic export. Requires confirmation. This returns an exact preview and a five-minute confirmation token; it does not apply the change.
